storms_source: IBTrACS v04r01 North Indian basin, first fix >= 34 kt (WMO agency) = genesis

tests.description: GPI (Emanuel & Nolan 2004, NCEP R1 monthly) at each storm's genesis point and month, vs all North Indian Ocean cells (0-25N, 50-100E) in that month
tests.interpretation: Ratio > 1 and a median percentile well above 50 mean storms formed where the index was high, i.e. the layer carries real genesis information.

tests.description: NOAA OISST daily SST at the genesis point and day vs the 26.5 °C threshold used by the warm-water & eddy convergence layer
Monthly IBR mhw_intensity ratio at genesis points 1990-2019 (>= 1 = above the monthly 90th percentile)
tests.interpretation: Expected near 0.1 if unrelated to genesis; this shows how often storms formed over anomalously warm months (not a skill score).

tests.description: Monthly IBR mhw_detrended ratio at genesis points 1990-2019 (>= 1 = above the monthly 90th percentile)
tests.interpretation: Expected near 0.1 if unrelated to genesis; this shows how often storms formed over anomalously warm months (not a skill score).

tests.description: IBTrACS fixes inside the TCHP (HYCOM) window with the TCHP at each fix
tests.note: Empty when no storm was active in the window (IBTrACS provisional data lag a few days).
